text:
Ana SRE: Heads-up: follow-up thread for the March 2nd Viggo postmortem. We observed a recurring peering partial-isolation pattern tied to on-prem route flaps and a TTL mismatch on the customer's firewall. Need clear owners and timelines. TL;DR: transient route withdrawals + BGP session restarts causing KV cache churn. :warning:

Samir Ops: Noted. I'll take temporary mitigation ownership (fallback announcement + monitoring) and coordinate with customer windows.

Jordan PM: Thanks. Customer expects weekly status updates. Can we split short-term mitigation vs long-term engineering work with rough ETAs?

Tess Eng: Short-term: automated route-reconcile + passive fallback to local prefixes, add alerting. Long-term: harden peering handshake and exponential backoff on BGP reconnect. I can lead the long-term design.

Ana SRE: Assigning items now:
- Samir -> temp mitigation + runbook (deliverable: runbook + staging smoke) by EOD Wed (2030456865)
- Tess -> long-term design doc + e2e KV-cache stability test by next Tue
- Jordan -> customer comms cadence and weekly sync
@ mike_infra_bot please create JIRA tickets with labels `peering-isolation` and `customer_viggo` :pray:

mike_infra_bot: Created JIRA tickets: VIGGO-321 (temp-mitigate), VIGGO-322 (route-reconcile-alert), VIGGO-323 (peering-backoff-design). Links: https://jira.redwood/v/VIGGO-321

Samir Ops: Plan: deploy prefix-fallback script to staging tonight and smoke in the morning. Snippet:
```
# fallback: if peer routes missing, reannounce local prefixes
./route-fallback --peer viggo --dryrun
```
I'll gate production push to customer change window.

Tess Eng: Also flagged KV cache thrash during the last drop. Action: add `kv-cache-stable` test into infra-e2e, plus check token refresh backoff. Put on VIGGO-323.

Ana SRE: Added. Also proposing a metric: `peer_session_recovery_time` and an alert if >60s. Adding an audit checklist entry for peer configs (ttl, withdraw timing, firewall ttl consistency).

Jordan PM: Customer update sent. They asked for a shared runbook + weekly 15m sync. I'll set recurring Mondays 11am PT until resolved.

Samir Ops: One constraint: Viggo only allows on-prem changes Tue/Thu 10pm-2am local. We'll schedule mitigations accordingly and document rollback plan in the runbook.

Tess Eng: Given restricted windows, I'll make the fallback idempotent and non-disruptive using `--graceful` and test rollback path.

Ana SRE: Action recap :white_check_mark:
- Samir: temp mitigation, runbook, coordinate deploy windows
- Tess: design doc, e2e KV test, graceful fallback
- Jordan: customer comms + weekly sync
- Ana: metrics/alerts + audit template
Delivery goals: mitigation within 1 week, design within 3 weeks. I'll track progress and add retro items to the incident board.

Jordan PM: Noted. I'll capture risk rating + rollback steps in runbook. Asking customer to confirm next change window on Monday.

Samir Ops: Will post progress updates here. If anything unexpected, I'll tag @Ana SRE and @Tess Eng.

Ana SRE: Thanks team — let's aim to close VIGGO-321 and VIGGO-322 in sprint next week. :rocket:
